answer_1.quote: We train speech-to-unit translation (S2UT) models... The S2UT model takes source speech as input and predicts a sequence of target discrete units... We then resynthesize speech using pretrained unit-based HiFi-GAN vocoders

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the transcriptions using SacreBLEU to compute BLEU and chrF2++ scores... We also adopt BLASER 2.0 to directly evaluate speech output
